findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: permits_search, licenses_search, contracts_search_opportunities · Private data: fedwatch_signal_search, permits_search, licenses_search, businesses_search, healthcare_search, property_search, enforcement_search, courts_search, ip_search, contracts_search_opportunities, contracts_search_bid_outcomes, liens_search · Public sink: contracts_search_opportunities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: permits_search, licenses_search, contracts_search_opportunities · Private data: fedwatch_signal_search, permits_search, licenses_search, businesses_search, healthcare_search, property_search, enforcement_search, courts_search, ip_search, contracts_search_opportunities, contracts_search_bid_outcomes, liens_search · Public sink: contracts_search_opportunities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
